semantics.clock: All input bits sampled at positive clock edges, as explicitly specified.
semantics.reset: Active-high synchronous reset has priority, aborts any frame, returns to idle and clears done at the sampled edge.
semantics.frame: An idle low sample is the start bit; the following eight rising edges capture data bits 0 through 7. The next rising edge samples the stop bit.
semantics.completion: A high expected stop sample asserts done immediately after that edge for one cycle, with the assembled byte. The next edge can accept a new low start bit.
semantics.bad_stop: A low expected stop sample rejects the byte and waits for a high sample. That high restores idle; only a subsequent low sample starts a new byte.
semantics.initialization: No power-up behavior is specified. Tests first apply a synchronous reset; out_byte is only checked when done is asserted.
semantics.output: out_byte is valid when done is 1 and is otherwise don't-care, explicitly specified.

numeric.data: Unsigned 8-bit byte, least significant serial bit first
numeric.counter: 3-bit index for exactly eight data samples
numeric.arithmetic: No numeric arithmetic, rounding or saturation

verification.oracle: Independent serial frame parser derived from original problem; compare after positive edges and NBA settling
cases: bad stop and long low recovery
verification.mandatory: smoke_environment.py then validate_contract.py then dev_check.py --label initial
verification.timeout: Bounded testbench timeout, fatal on mismatch, explicit PASS marker

specification_ambiguities.text: It should assert done each time it finds a stop bit
specification_ambiguities.resolution: Interpret stop bit as the correctly positioned stop of a valid frame. A late high after a missing stop only resynchronizes, because the original requires correctly received bytes and waiting before attempting the next byte.

specification_ambiguities.text: Reset value of out_byte and pre-reset behavior are unspecified
specification_ambiguities.resolution: Implementation clears byte on reset; verification does not constrain byte outside done or check pre-reset state.
